description: A PHP source file for the TestLink project that implements functionality to compare different versions of test cases, generate diffs between them, and display the results in a web interface.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves arguments from the request, setting defaults for comparing test case versions.

methods.name: initializeGUI
methods.description: Sets up the GUI data structure, including test case versions, labels, and configuration.

methods.name: buildDiff
methods.description: Constructs a diff structure between specified test case versions for comparison display.
